column6: One sentence says what the project is and for whom, the problem is stated in the user's terms, and no course vocabulary (capstone, team, partner, sprint, rubric) appears on the page.
column9: A visitor can tell what the project is and who it is for, but no one sentence says both, the problem is stated in the team's terms rather than the user's, or course vocabulary appears on the page.
column12: A visitor cannot tell what the project is or who it is for.

column3: 3 to 5 audience-perspective highlights, at least one real visual of the project in action, and a working call to action
column6: Three to five highlights written from the audience's perspective, at least one real visual of the project actually running, and a call to action that says what it does and works.
column9: Highlights are present but list features rather than what each does from the audience's perspective, the visual is a mockup or placeholder, or the call to action does not say what it does (Download, Play, Try it, View on GitHub, Read the paper).
column12: No highlights, no visual of the project at all, or no way to access it.

column3: everyone credited, past contributors acknowledged where applicable, feedback channel present
column6: Every team member credited, past contributors acknowledged where applicable, and a working feedback or contact channel.
column9: Credits present but incomplete, or a contact channel is named without being usable.

column6: No placeholder text; alt text on every meaningful image, 4.5:1 contrast on body text, descriptive link text (not "click here"), and no broken link, image, or embed.
column9: No placeholder text, and the page fails one of these checks: alt text on every meaningful image, 4.5:1 contrast on body text, no "click here" link text, no broken link, image, or embed.
column12: Placeholder text (lorem ipsum, an empty section), or the page fails two or more of the checks in Meets.
